$Comment: What a player sees and hears the instant a title is unlocked for them, whether a quest or an
achievement paid it as a Title reward or an administrator ran /zigtitle grant. It fires only for a
title the player did not already have; granting one again is silent.
This is the library's own neutral default, so a bare server gets a notice out of the box. A mod
that ships a file with this same name in its own pack replaces it, and a server owner can do the
same from the owner layer. Override the whole file rather than editing this one; a mod with a
titles button of its own points the second line at that button instead of the command.
The moment carries 'title' (its id) and 'name' (what the title is called, already in the reader's
language: its TitleKey, else title.<id>.name from whichever lang file ships it, else the id
spelled out). 'player' is always the name of who unlocked it.
Key is a line from a .lang file; Args names which of those values fill its blanks, in order.
Sound is any SoundEvent id, played at the player's own position. Tone colours the whole
notification: gold Reward here, because an unlock is a payout.
